title: 中金Kevin Lou：科技高赔率低胜率，用期权对冲尾部风险
speaker: Kevin Lou

segments.en: Maybe cut some exposure to be narrowing your exposure to the technology to avoid potential volatility. But that's the key trend.
segments.zh: 或许减少一些科技敞口以规避潜在波动。但科技仍是关键趋势。

segments.en: Before the rest part, if you have assets with very high-pair ratio, but low-wind ratio, for example, his technology, use part of the shares to batch. It's like a long-dated option value.
segments.zh: 对于高赔率低胜率的资产，比如科技股，可以用部分持股做备兑开仓，就像长期期权价值。

segments.en: But in the next half, if we're going to see some normalization of so-called K-shaped divide, which I believe US have probably better chance as long as the US youth come down, we probably can batch actual alpha or cyclicals.
segments.zh: 但下半年，如果K型分化有所正常化——我认为只要美国利率下降，美国市场机会更大——我们或许可以捕捉真正的阿尔法或周期股。

segments.en: So that's why HSEI's lack behind due to the consumption, due to the lower lack of the k-shaped. That's reflected.
segments.zh: 这就是恒生指数落后的原因——消费疲弱和K型分化。这已经反映在价格中。

segments.en: Tell me about the credit to household. You think it's a leading indicator. What happened last time when we started to see things drop?
segments.zh: 谈谈居民信贷吧。您认为它是领先指标。上次我们开始看到数据下滑时发生了什么？

segments.en: Well, last time September 24th, when people are not waiting to borrow, when people are prepared their mortgage is called credit contraction or balance recession.
segments.zh: 去年9月24日，当人们不愿借贷、提前还贷时，就出现了信贷收缩或资产负债表衰退。

segments.en: And then the policy is step in to pivot to consumption, to provide most stimulus to consumption and actually trade in policy, all those stuff, to study to boost the demand.
segments.zh: 随后政策介入，转向消费，提供大量消费刺激，还有以旧换新等，旨在提振需求。
